design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (order_item_refunds_fees_and_tips, category order). frozen_time 2026-09-23 10:15:00 CDT.

1. Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems 3, factor_counts [4, 5, 5, 6]. Taken: unfound-line refund 4, wrong-item refund 5, over-cap amount 5, limit-review claim 6.

2. Why a good test. The customer asks one thing — money back for two melted tubs of Häagen-Dazs (line 1, 11.58). The agent cannot answer it from one record: the limit-review claim policy says the claim is weighed against the rolling limits only after the refund of every line billed although recorded not found stands, and is registered only once every over-cap amount on the order stands as a review request. Reading the order entries, the agent must discover (a) line 3 (Kirkland Raw Jumbo Shrimp 2 lb, 49.98) billed although the decision row records not_found_refunded, (b) whose refund is fixed only after every wrong-item refund stands, (c) line 2 billed as Almond Breeze Vanilla although the approved replacement was Almond Breeze Unsweetened, and (d) that the shrimp refund stops at the per-order room, leaving an over-cap amount to register. After those three writes the rolling count of issue refunds is 6 (4 on the July/August/September orders + wrong_item + missing), not below the Standard Delivery limit 6, so the ice cream cannot be refunded by the agent and becomes the customer's own limit-review claim (owner=user). Difficulty comes from policy reading, a 4-deep chain, cross-order rolling counts, membership ledger tiers and exact arithmetic, never from tool choice (each write has exactly one tool).

3. Scope. Occupied before: nothing (task 0). Claimed: order_ext_wrong_item_kept_refund, order_ext_unfound_line_refund, order_ext_over_cap_review_amount, order_ext_limit_review_claim_amount; tools refund_wrong_item_79d6dec9, refund_unfound_item_93423917, register_over_cap_review_9b0d89a0, submit_limit_review_claim_079a4c96 (user). Reserved for task 1 (independent tree, 3 prerequisite problems): weight overage, substitution price protection, service-fee share and the customer's photo-review claim — a disjoint write family (weighted/substituted lines, fee refunds, photo review).

4. Problem-tree card. Root LR = order_ext_limit_review_claim_amount (user). Edges:
 - LR -> OC (value_input, gate lr_over_cap_requests, state form): "A limit-review claim is registered only once the part of every line recorded as not found that lies above its unfound-line room stands as a submitted over-cap review request." Only the over-cap policy's write registers that part. False at opening: no review request on the order (find_order_review_requests returns none) while line 3 (49.98) exceeds the room. Skip effect: claim 17.78 instead of 18.78.
 - LR -> M (state_gate, gate order_events.refund_reason, state form): "A limit-review claim is weighed against the rolling limits only after the refund of every line billed although recorded as not found stands on the order." Only the unfound-line policy books a missing refund on such a line. False at opening: line 3 charge row refund_reason null, decision row not_found_refunded. Skip effect: rolling count 5 < 6 — the claim would not be forced to review; order-load credit falls to 0.
 - OC -> M (value_input, gate oc_missing_granted, negated form): "The over-cap amount is not registered until the refund of the unfound line stands on the order up to the room left under the per-order cap." Skip effect: 60.16 instead of 11.30.
 - M -> WI (value_input, gate m_granted_on_order, affirmative): "The unfound-line refund is fixed only after every wrong-item refund owed on the order's approved replacements stands on the order." Only the wrong-item policy books wrong_item refunds for approved replacements. False at opening: order_events ef8b0e14 substitute 'Almond Breeze Vanilla Almond Milk 64 oz' vs decision a999fb04 'Almond Breeze Unsweetened Almond Milk 64 oz', no wrong_item refund. Skip effect: 49.98 instead of 48.86.
 Four-point test: each sentence has an ordering connective (only once / only after / not until / only after), waits on a record-visible entry named in record words, names no tool/id/code token, and states the hard requirement at exactly the edge's scope. Directions are mixed (affirmative for a figure fixed, negated for a registration that waits). Topological order WI -> M -> OC -> LR is unique (chain). Owner=user problem: LR, handed over by unlock_user_discoverable_tool -> call_user_discoverable_tool. No edge rests on a real-world wait; every write is synchronous at frozen_time.

5. Base-invariant card (every write is subject order_item_refunded). order_agg_refund_review.under_rolling_limits is superseded clause by clause by the limit-review policy's declared overwrite (restated in the extended rule: count of issue refunds in the rolling 90 days below refund_count_90d_limit 6 and amount plus the request within 150.00). At WI: count 4, amount 22.76+6.27 -> ok. At M: count 5, amount 29.03+48.86=77.89 <= 150 -> ok. At LR: count 6 -> not below 6 -> claim goes to review. order_evt_item_refunds.completed_order: orders a7a473c0.status completed. issue_window (time): anchor orders.completed_at 2026-09-21 (day 0), issue_report_window_days 3 -> last day 2026-09-24 inclusive; 2026-09-23 inside; 2026-09-25 would be refused. once_per_line_reason: no refund stands on lines 1, 2, 3; each amount is below the line's charge minus refunds (6.27 < 7.58, 48.86 < 49.98). order_evt_substitutions.rejectable_substitution: no rejection is written. order_evt_weighted_items / order_evt_alcohol_and_returns: scope only (no weighted, no alcohol, order not returned or closed).

6. Business-object card. Order a7a473c0 (Mariano's, Standard Delivery). Line 2 charge ef8b0e14 (7.58) + decision a999fb04 -> wrong_item refund. Line 3 charge f7f9683e (49.98) + decision 05f620e1 -> missing refund + over-cap request. Line 1 charge 9af1e873 (11.58) -> customer's claim. Lines 4, 5, fees (service 3.99 charged, waivers 3.99 delivery and 1.99 service) and tip 3.50 enter only aggregates (item subtotal 79.71, fee sums). Closed orders 6b561ca5, b4cf0c35, 35beea62 carry the four earlier refunds (4.99 missing, 5.29 damaged, 5.99 quality, 6.49 wrong_item), each tied to its own charge entry; they only enter the rolling count.

7. Factor card (Step 5 run, handling-time worlds). Wrong-item refund 6.27 (baseline 3.03): keep share monthly+6 fees -> 60 (baseline 40 -> 4.59); value basis billed 3.79 < original 3.99 -> 7.98 (charge 7.58 -> 5.97); class points perishable+delivery -> +10 (0 -> 5.43); basket uplift 79.71 & 5 lines -> 5% (0 -> 5.99); standing credit 2 days & none standing -> 0.40 (0 -> 5.87). Unfound-line refund 48.86 (baseline 33.58): cap share 55 (50 -> 44.57); cap basis subtotal + waivers 85.69 (79.71 -> 45.57); top-up 5.00 (0 -> 43.86); tenure 37 months -> 3.00 (0 -> 45.86). Over-cap amount 11.30 (baseline 1.12): claim value 52.98 (49.98 -> 7.99); fee part 2.65 (0 -> 8.52); loyalty 5% (0 -> 8.52); days credit 1.00 (0 -> 10.30); handling 0.75 (0 -> 10.55). Limit-review claim 18.78 (baseline 11.58): claim value 12.58 (11.58 -> 17.63); fee part 0.63 (0 -> 18.09); goodwill 10% (0 -> 17.46); days credit 1.50 (0 -> 17.28); order load 2.00 (0 -> 16.78); basket 0.75 (0 -> 18.03). Cross-difficulty evidence: memberships 5936922e (Cartwise+ Monthly, enrolled 2023-08-15) and six membership_fee_charged rows 2026-04-15..2026-09-15. Multi-source: every membership ladder combines plan cycle AND ledger count. Near-misses (records the rules exclude that would flip a tier if counted): the wrong_item refund 6.49 on closed order 35beea62 (counted 'on the order', the standing credit would drop to 0); the missing refund 4.99 on 6b561ca5 (counted, the room top-up would drop to 0 and the granted sum would rise); line 3 as a perishable as-ordered line (excluded from the claimed line by its not-found decision). Month windows follow the stated anniversary convention: the 2026-09-15 fee is 0 months old and counts. No stamp decides a tier.

8. Persona. Eleanor Fairbanks, teacher, brief and practical; volunteers only the melted ice cream and her wish for money back; gives phone 3125521846 and email eleanor.fairbanks@inboxly.com when asked (DOB/ZIP as a third detail); asked about other items she only says she did not check the rest of the bags, so the almond milk and the shrimp reach the agent only through the prerequisite sentences and the records; agrees to other corrections; submits the claim only when handed over, with the agent's figures; ends once the claim is in. No prerequisite is named or hinted.

9. Standard solution. find_customers(3125521846) -> verify (phone+email) -> find_orders / find_order_events (customer) -> find_memberships / find_membership_events -> find_order_review_requests -> WI 6.27 -> M 48.86 -> OC 11.30 -> hand over LR 18.78.

10. Verification. Code: scratch evalchain replays the plan with the real tools and check_compute's evaluator; per-task gates run: check_extended OK, check_task_tools OK, replay_tasks OK (15 actions, closure 31 = initial 31), check_solvability OK, check_compute OK (4 comps, 20 factors, 7 cross), check_grounding OK, check_cross_fire OK.

11. Draft recomputation from visible context. From the published rules, the order entries and the membership ledger alone: line 2 mismatch -> 6.27; room 47.13+5.00+3.00-6.27 -> 48.86; over-cap 58.41-48.86+1.75 -> 11.30; rolling count 6 -> claim 14.53+1.50+2.00+0.75 -> 18.78. Agrees with gold.

12. Revisions. (a) limit-review window credit read only tier params -> replaced by basket credit (records). (b) wrong-item baseline paragraph named factors -> struck. (c) Added LR -> M state_gate so the rolling-limit judgement of the claim is taken after the unfound-line refund (otherwise granting the ice cream first would change which later write crosses the limit).

13. Rework round 2 (policy-task audit). T0-C1: persona no longer knows the almond milk or the shrimp; no_user_hint rewritten. T0-T1 / X-1: the fee-share rule now shares the service fee back only once a price-protection or weight-overage refund stands (declared override of the base proportional sentence); this order carries only wrong_item and missing refunds, so no fee share is owed here and gold needs none. T0-T2 / E-1: every rule with a month window states the anniversary convention ("a fee charged earlier in the current month is 0 months old"), so the six fees 2026-04-15..2026-09-15 all count (5..0 months) and the monthly tiers are the only reading; figures unchanged. T0-T3 / F-2 / F-3: the unfound-line and over-cap rules state that their room governs only a line recorded as not found and that every other issue refund keeps the base per-order cap; the limit-review rule states that a claim crossing the rolling limits books nothing and registers no over-cap request, and sentence L2 now names only the not-found line's over-cap part — the ice cream claim has one write set. T0-P1 / F-1: both policies declare the overwrite of "A not_found_refunded line is never billed, so it has nothing to refund." Gold figures unchanged: 6.27 / 48.86 / 11.30 / 18.78 (re-run: all factor baselines as in section 7).
user_scenario:
You are Eleanor Fairbanks, a middle-school science teacher in Chicago who orders groceries on Cartwise between grading and after-school practice. You are calling on your lunch break, friendly but a little pressed for time, and you speak in short, practical sentences. Your Mariano's delivery came Monday evening, a little before seven, and both tubs of the Häagen-Dazs vanilla bean ice cream were completely melted, basically soup in the carton, so you had to pour them out. You want your money back for those two tubs of ice cream; that is the only thing you are calling about.
You give details only as the agent asks for them. Your mobile number is 3125521846 and your email is eleanor.fairbanks@inboxly.com; if a third detail is needed, your date of birth is 1979-11-02 and your home ZIP code is 60657. The order is the Mariano's one that was delivered on Monday, September 21, and it had two tubs of the ice cream on it. You did not take a photo before pouring them out, and you have no receipt other than what the app shows. If the agent asks where money back should go, back to your card is fine. If the agent asks about the other items on that order, you say you unpacked in a hurry, did not check the rest of the bags against the order, and have nothing else to report; you ask for nothing else.
You are happy for the agent to look into the order and take care of whatever needs doing on it; you do not know Cartwise's rules and you trust the agent to work them out. If the agent tells you about other corrections on the order, you simply say that sounds fine and thank them. If the agent explains that the ice cream cannot be refunded on the spot and has to go to the review team as a claim you submit yourself, you agree without arguing, and once the agent hands the claim over to you with the figures to enter, you submit it exactly as given and read back the reference and status you see. You do not question the amounts the agent quotes and you never suggest a figure of your own. Once you have submitted the ice cream claim and seen that it is in, you thank the agent and say goodbye.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's Cartwise profile from the mobile number she states and read its customer reference number.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed on the customer reference number; the profile lookup is the only way to obtain it.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm the caller owns the profile with the two details she gives (mobile number and email).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No account detail may be discussed and no change made before the identity check passes with 2 matching details.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read all of the customer's orders: the Mariano's Standard Delivery order completed 2026-09-21T18:40:00 (status completed, membership recorded) and the three closed orders of July, August and September 2026.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Gives the order number, service level (Standard Delivery tier parameters: cap 75.00 / 50 percent, issue window 3 days, rolling limits 6 / 150.00), completed_at for the issue window and the day counts, placed_date for the tenure allowance, and the other orders whose refunds enter the rolling 90-day count.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every entry on the customer's orders: the five billed lines of the Mariano's order with their prices and substitution outcomes, the two substitution decisions (line 2 approved Almond Breeze Unsweetened, line 3 not found), the service fee billed and the two member waivers, and the four refunds on the closed orders.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Discovers the unmet prerequisites (line 2 billed as Almond Breeze Vanilla although the approved replacement was Almond Breeze Unsweetened; line 3 billed 49.98 although recorded not found) and supplies every history input of the four computations plus the rolling 90-day count (4 at the opening).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Cartwise+ membership recorded on the order: Cartwise+ Monthly, active, enrolled 2023-08-15.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The plan's billing cycle and member service-fee rate and the enrollment date decide the keep share, cap share, tenure allowance, fee parts and goodwill raise.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the membership ledger: six period fees of 9.99 charged monthly from 2026-04-15 to 2026-09-15.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The count of period fees in the last 6 and 12 whole months decides the membership tiers of four factors (cross-difficulty evidence).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Check whether any review request already stands on the Mariano's order (none at the opening).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The over-cap request and the limit-review claim are registered only when none stands for the same amount; the order-load credit of the claim reads the count of submitted over-cap requests.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the wrong-item refund action named by the wrong-item policy.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the wrong-item refund of 6.27 on line 2 (Almond Breeze Vanilla handed over in place of the approved Almond Breeze Unsweetened), returned to the original payment method.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: order_ext_wrong_item_kept_refund computes 6.27; the unfound-line refund is fixed only after this refund stands, because it enters the refunds already granted against the per-order room.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount_usd: 6.27. Wrong-item value: billed 3.79 below original 3.99 -> original 3.99 x 2 billed units = 7.98 (baseline would take the charge 7.58). Keep share: Cartwise+ Monthly with 6 period fees (2026-04-15..2026-09-15) in the last 6 whole months -> 60 (baseline 40). Class points: perishable on a delivering service level -> +10. Basket uplift: item subtotal 79.71 >= 50.00 with 5 billed lines -> 5 percent. 7.98 x 70 / 100 x 1.05 = 5.8653 -> 5.87; standing credit: completed 2026-09-21, today 2026-09-23 = 2 days and no wrong-item refund standing -> +0.40 = 6.27, below the guard 7.58 - 0 = 7.58.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.customer_id: a637e3ae-7a7b-4ffd-a8b6-cb5bbe92cbfd. Basis: tool docstring 'the customer reference number of the person who placed the order, read from the customer profile lookup'. Uniqueness: find_customers on 3125521846 returns exactly this profile and orders.a7a473c0-d3f9-40a3-bc05-2a5213552a1a.customer_id equals it.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.order_id: a7a473c0-d3f9-40a3-bc05-2a5213552a1a. Basis: the wrong-item rule applies to 'a line whose substitution the customer approved' on the order; the only order with such a line is the Mariano's order (order_events.ef8b0e14-fa3c-4b32-a60d-d472a5e8776f.order_id). Uniqueness: the three closed orders carry no approved substitution.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.line_number: 2. Basis: order_events row ef8b0e14-fa3c-4b32-a60d-d472a5e8776f line_number 2, substitution_decision approved_by_customer, substitute_item_name 'Almond Breeze Vanilla Almond Milk 64 oz' vs the decision row's 'Almond Breeze Unsweetened Almond Milk 64 oz'. Uniqueness: line 2 is the only approved replacement on the order.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_event_id: ef8b0e14-fa3c-4b32-a60d-d472a5e8776f. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the billed item line entry (the line charge) this refund pays back'. Uniqueness: exactly one order_item_charged entry exists for line 2.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.refund_reason: wrong_item. Basis: the rule 'the line is refunded with refund_reason wrong_item' and the docstring 'wrong_item — a different product from the one ordered or approved was handed over'. Uniqueness: missing (it was handed over), damaged/quality (no defect), substitution_rejected (the customer rejected nothing and an approved line cannot be rejected), the price and weight reasons and the fee-only reasons do not describe a different product.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the refund of 48.86 on line 3 (Kirkland Raw Jumbo Shrimp 2 lb billed 49.98 although the shopper recorded it not found), up to the room left under the per-order cap.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: order_ext_unfound_line_refund computes 48.86 on the world where the 6.27 wrong-item refund already stands; the over-cap amount waits on this refund.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount_usd: 48.86. Unfound-line charge 49.98 (no missing refund yet). Cap share: Monthly plan with 6 period fees in 6 months -> 55 (baseline 50). Cap basis: the order carries waivers (3.99 delivery + 1.99 service = 5.98) and a billed service fee -> 79.71 + 5.98 = 85.69 (baseline 79.71). 85.69 x 55 / 100 = 47.13 (lower than cap 75.00). Top-up: 2 days since completion and no missing refund -> +5.00. Tenure allowance: enrolled 2023-08-15, placed 2026-09-20 -> 37 whole months -> +3.00. Granted refunds on the order: wrong_item 6.27 -> room 47.13 + 5.00 + 3.00 - 6.27 = 48.86 < 49.98, so the refund is 48.86.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.customer_id: a637e3ae-7a7b-4ffd-a8b6-cb5bbe92cbfd. Basis: profile lookup, same as the earlier call. Uniqueness: one verified profile.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.order_id: a7a473c0-d3f9-40a3-bc05-2a5213552a1a. Basis: order_events.f7f9683e-9309-4d95-be20-82ba229c3fb2.order_id. Uniqueness: the only order carrying a billed line recorded not found.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.line_number: 3. Basis: order_events f7f9683e-9309-4d95-be20-82ba229c3fb2 line_number 3 with substitution_decision not_found_refunded and a decision row for line 3 not_found_refunded. Uniqueness: the only not-found line.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_event_id: f7f9683e-9309-4d95-be20-82ba229c3fb2. Basis: docstring 'the billed item line entry this refund pays back'. Uniqueness: one charge entry for line 3.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.refund_reason: missing. Basis: rule 'its charge is refunded with refund_reason missing'; docstring 'missing — the billed product never reached the customer'. Uniqueness: wrong_item/damaged/quality need a handed-over product; the other reasons do not describe an unfound product.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Register for review the over-cap amount of 11.30 on line 3, the part of the shrimp line's value above the booked 48.86.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: order_ext_over_cap_review_amount computes 11.30 once the 48.86 missing refund stands; the limit-review claim is registered only once this request stands.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.requested_amount_usd: 11.30. Claim value: billed 24.99 below original 26.49 -> 26.49 x 2 = 52.98 (baseline 49.98). Fee part: member-rate service waiver 1.99 stands and the Monthly plan's member_service_fee_rate_pct is 5.0 -> 52.98 x 5 / 100 = 2.65 (baseline 0). Loyalty raise: 6 period fees in 6 months -> 5 percent: 55.63 x 1.05 = 58.41. Less the missing refund standing 48.86 -> 9.55. Days credit: 2 days and the line is perishable -> +1.00; handling credit: delivering service level with 5 billed lines -> +0.75. Total 11.30.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.customer_id: a637e3ae-7a7b-4ffd-a8b6-cb5bbe92cbfd. Basis: profile lookup. Uniqueness: one verified profile.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.order_id: a7a473c0-d3f9-40a3-bc05-2a5213552a1a. Basis: the order whose unfound line stopped at the room. Uniqueness: only order with an unfound line.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.line_number: 3. Basis: the rule registers the over-cap amount 'on that line' — the line recorded as not found (line 3). Uniqueness: the only line whose refund stopped at the room.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.refund_reason: missing. Basis: the rule 'with its refund_reason missing'. Uniqueness: the request continues the missing refund of line 3; the other three literals describe handed-over products.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the customer's own limit-review claim so it can be handed over to her.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The limit-review claim is the customer's own act; the agent unlocks it and hands it over with the figures to enter.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The customer submits her claim for the two melted tubs of Häagen-Dazs on line 1 for 18.78 to the review team.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: order_ext_limit_review_claim_amount computes 18.78 once the unfound-line refund and the over-cap request stand; with the wrong-item and missing refunds the rolling count is 6, not below the limit 6, so the agent cannot book the refund and the claim is the customer's own.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.requested_amount_usd: 18.78. Claim value: billed 5.79 below original 6.29 -> 6.29 x 2 = 12.58 (baseline 11.58). Fee part: member-rate waiver stands -> 12.58 x 5.0 / 100 = 0.63. Goodwill raise: Monthly plan with 6 period fees in 6 months -> 10 percent: 13.21 x 1.10 = 14.53. Days credit: 2 days since completion and 2 units billed -> +1.50. Order-load credit: 2 issue refunds (wrong_item 6.27, missing 48.86) and 1 submitted over-cap request -> +2.00. Basket credit: 5 billed lines and item subtotal 79.71 >= 50.00 -> +0.75. Total 18.78.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.customer_id: a637e3ae-7a7b-4ffd-a8b6-cb5bbe92cbfd. Basis: handed over by the agent from the profile lookup (docstring). Uniqueness: one verified profile.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.order_id: a7a473c0-d3f9-40a3-bc05-2a5213552a1a. Basis: the customer's 'Mariano's order' delivered Monday evening; the only completed Mariano's order. Uniqueness: the other Mariano's orders are closed.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.line_number: 1. Basis: order_events 9af1e873-ca71-44ae-bdfc-16e206d4d4e7 line 1 'Häagen-Dazs Vanilla Bean Ice Cream 14 oz', the product the customer names. Uniqueness: the only ice cream line.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.refund_reason: quality. Basis: the docstring 'quality — the product arrived spoiled, melted, expired or otherwise unfit' and the customer's report that both tubs arrived melted. Uniqueness: missing (they arrived), damaged (not broken or leaking packaging), wrong_item (the right product) do not fit.

factor_trace: wrong_item_keep_share (parameter, cross-difficulty membership, multi-source): memberships 5936922e (Cartwise+ Monthly, billing_cycle monthly) AND 6 membership_fee_charged rows 2026-04-15..2026-09-15 within 6 whole months -> tier 1, 60 percent; baseline 40 percent gives 4.59.
wrong_item_value_basis (method): line 2 billed 3.79 below original 3.99 -> original price x 2 billed units = 7.98; baseline (line charge 7.58) gives 5.97.
wrong_item_class_points (parameter): line 2 item_category perishable on Standard Delivery (fulfillment_mode delivery) -> +10 points; baseline 0 gives 5.43.
wrong_item_basket_uplift (parameter): item subtotal 79.71 >= 50.00 AND 5 billed lines -> 5 percent; baseline 0 gives 5.99.
wrong_item_standing_credit (parameter): DAYS(2026-09-21, 2026-09-23) = 2 AND no wrong_item refund standing -> 0.40; baseline 0 gives 5.87.
plumbing: wi_line_charge 7.58, wi_line_units 2, wi_line_refunded 0.00; result = RND(MN(7.58, RND(7.98 x 70/100 x 1.05) + 0.40)) = RND(MN(7.58, 5.87 + 0.40)) = 6.27.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: membership on a monthly plan AND at least 6 period fees in the last 6 whole months
